title: Katherine Hsiao Data Equity term start depth 3
summary: Official WEF records establish that the 2023-2024 Data Equity council term had already kicked off by the publication of WEF's 2022-2023 annual report on 6 September 2023, while the October 2023 Data Equity report directly fixes Katherine Hsiao to the council member roster. The exact kickoff date and Hsiao join date remain unresolved.

gaps: The exact calendar date on which the Data Equity council term began remains unresolved.

caveats: Identifying Data Equity as one of the eight focused councils is an inference from the annual report's same-section enumeration of eight council focus areas plus its statement that eight focused councils kicked off two-year terms.
The October 2023 report directly establishes Hsiao membership by that point but not necessarily the first day of her service.

provenance.method: official annual-report term inference plus direct contributor-roster confirmation

data.question: By what date was the Data Equity council term underway, and by what date is Hsiao directly fixed to it?
data.method: Read WEF annual-report statements in section context, compare the exact eight listed council focus areas to the eight councils said to have kicked off two-year terms, then confirm Hsiao on the October 2023 contributor roster.
data.scope: Start boundary of WEF Global Future Council on Data Equity 2023-2024 and Katherine Hsiao membership.
findings: WEF's Annual Report 2022-2023 was published on 6 September 2023 and says eight focused Fourth Industrial Revolution Global Future Councils kicked off their two-year term during the reporting period.
The same annual-report section enumerates eight Global Future Council focus areas including data equity, supporting the inference that the Data Equity council was among those launched terms.
WEF's 5 October 2023 preview calls the 16-18 October meeting the first in-person meeting of the council members' two-year term.
The October 2023 Data Equity report labels the roster Global Future Council on Data Equity 2023-2024 and directly names Katherine Hsiao as a member.
conclusions: The Data Equity term was underway by 6 September 2023 with high confidence.
Hsiao is directly confirmed as a Data Equity council member by October 2023.
The exact kickoff date and Hsiao's exact first day remain unresolved and should not be invented.
limitations: The annual-report launch sentence and focus-area list require a same-section inference rather than an explicit sentence saying Data Equity launched on a named date.
